parts.value: The footer version opens a separate changelog with edition badges and links to related issues and pull requests; About remains under Help.
Reformulated button labels in the clear form confirmation dialog. "Clear" instead of "Reset"
Related Work now starts empty and uses accessible cards that can be added, collapsed, removed, and reordered with buttons or drag and drop.
Related Work XML imports and exports now use XSLT-backed mappings, preserve entry order, and show progress when importing large lists.
The Contributors form group now starts empty and combines person and institution entries in one ordered card list.
Authors and Contributors share one contact requirement. Contributor persons can use the Contact Person role; contributor institutions can use it when
SHOW_CONTACT_INSTITUTION=true
Contributor order, roles, affiliations and contact details are preserved when saving and loading XML.

ELMO-GEM now branches on the DOI field at submit: if it is empty, GFZ Data Services receives the usual submission mail (DatasetController envelope) and is asked to report the reserved DOI to ICGEM; if a DOI is already present, that Data Services mail is skipped.

The ICGEM team always receives the ICGEM metadata file (IcgmController) together with the next step for the ICGEM database: wait for the DOI from Data Services, or upload straight away when a DOI was already provided.
ELMO-GEM no longer offers the data description template upload in the submit dialog.
ELMO-GEM's ICGEM registration email now links to the upload URL configured with
ICGEM_UPLOAD_URL
ELMO-GEM can skip researcher confirmation emails when
SEND_RESEARCHER_CONFIRMATION_EMAIL
is false.
Submission errors that were not caused by the mail server are reported as JSON again instead of ending the request without a response.
Fixed inconsistent visibility of help buttons in form group headings.
DataCite relation types are exported as canonical schema values without spaces while retaining readable labels in the editor.
Manual Related Work identifier-type selections are no longer overwritten by a delayed automatic detection result.

Fixed DataCite 4.7 exports for Resource Types whose display labels contain spaces by writing canonical whitespace-free values to the
resourceTypeGeneral
